item.title: Nation marks 25th anniversary of 9/11 with ceremonies, Trump and Vance attend
item.description: The 25th anniversary of 9/11 brought together current and former national leaders across party lines at the three attack sites, reflecting the attacks' enduring place as a shared national touchpoint even amid contemporary political divisions. item.title: Houthis seize strategic Red Sea port and island, threatening key shipping route
item.description: Iran-backed Houthi forces have seized the port city of Mocha, the coastal town of Dhubab, and the island of Perim (Mayyun Island) in the Bab al-Mandeb strait, giving them control of Yemen’s entire Red Sea coast, according to Yemeni government sources and witnesses. item.title: August CPI rises 3.4%, core inflation tops forecasts, solidifying case for Fed rate hike
item.description: The consumer price index rose a seasonally adjusted 0.4% in August, putting the 12-month inflation rate at 3.4%, the Bureau of Labor Statistics reported Friday. The annual figure matched July's pace and came in above the 3.3% expected by economists polled by FactSet, though it was in line with the…

item.title: Russia strikes Kyiv petrol stations with jet-powered drones; Poland warns of intensified provocations
item.description: Russia launched 149 drones into Ukraine overnight, including jet-powered Shahed strike drones, hitting petrol stations in the capital Kyiv for the first time.
